title: What do you regard as the greatest character transformation, within a single film?

commenti.body:
Viggo Mortensen in A History of Violence comes to mind. A seemingly normal man for almost half of the movie turns into a violent psycho in the blink of an eye

Michael Corleone is like, the most famous example which happens over the course of two movies

Jack Nicholson in the Shining is another
I love The Shining in terms of its wider subtlety and the superb acting of Philip Stone. However, does Jack himself change that much?

Not sure about GREATEST, but here are three that I thought were impactful and well done.

Antonio / Bicycle Thieves (1948)  
T.E. Lawrence / Lawrence of Arabia (1962)  
Bella / Poor Things (2023)
